errors:after-used-as-connector-before-cl.title: after 不宜直接当 later 连接后续动作
errors:after-used-as-connector-before-cl.explanation: 表达“后来……”时，after 不能直接替代 later/then/afterward 来承接后续动作；自然说法是 but later settled 或 but then settled。
errors:after-used-as-connector-before-cl.source: 表达“后来……”时，after 不能直接替代 later/then/afterward 来承接后续动作；自然说法是 but later settled 或 but then settled。

errors:arrive-from-vs-arrive-in.title: 把 from 误选成 in
errors:arrive-from-vs-arrive-in.explanation: 表示“从某地到来”时要用 arrive from + 出发地；arrive in 更强调“到达某个大地点/城市”。这里 Boston 是出发地来源，不是目的地介词用法。
errors:arrive-from-vs-arrive-in.example: They welcomed the traveler who had just arrived from Boston.

errors:articles-with-specific-event-and-.title: 具体事件和地点名词前的冠词
errors:articles-with-specific-event-and-.explanation: 提到双方都明确的具体会议、实验室、办公室等可数名词时，通常需要冠词或限定词，例如 after the meeting、visit the lab。缺少冠词会显得不完整或像泛指。
errors:articles-with-specific-event-and-.source: After meeting, we continued to visit lab.
errors:articles-with-specific-event-and-.example: After the meeting, we continued to visit the lab.

errors:company-headquarters-not-head.title: 公司总部常用 headquarters
errors:company-headquarters-not-head.explanation: 表达“公司总部”通常用 headquarters，而不是 head；head 更常指人或身体部位。
errors:company-headquarters-not-head.source: 表达“公司总部”通常用 headquarters，而不是 head；head 更常指人或身体部位。

errors:former-residence-needs-past-tense.title: 以前住在某地要用过去表达
errors:former-residence-needs-past-tense.explanation: 中文“以前/过去住在某地”强调过去状态，英语通常用 lived in 或 used to live in；不要用一般现在时 live in 表示过去居住。
errors:former-residence-needs-past-tense.source: My parents live in New York, but now they live in Los Angeles.
errors:former-residence-needs-past-tense.example: My parents used to live in New York, but now they live in Los Angeles.

errors:history-of-not-about-place.title: history of a place 的介词搭配
errors:history-of-not-about-place.explanation: 表达“某地的历史”时，英语通常说 the history of the town/place，而不是 the history about the town；about 更像“关于……的内容”，of 更自然地表示所属关系。
errors:history-of-not-about-place.source: 表达“某地的历史”时，英语通常说 the history of the town/place，而不是 the history about the town；about 更像“关于……的内容”，of 更自然地表示所属关系。

errors:learn-about-possessive-history.title: 了解某地历史的自然表达
errors:learn-about-possessive-history.explanation: “了解某地的历史”使用 learn about the history of a place 或 learn about the place’s history，不能说 get the history this city。
errors:learn-about-possessive-history.source: follow guide to get the history this city
errors:learn-about-possessive-history.example: They followed the guide to learn about the city's history.

errors:missing-for-after-wait.title: wait 后遗漏介词 for
errors:missing-for-after-wait.explanation: 表示等待某人或某物时应使用 wait for somebody/something，不能直接使用 wait somebody。
errors:missing-for-after-wait.source: 表示等待某人或某物时应使用 wait for somebody/something，不能直接使用 wait somebody。

errors:missing-the-before-specific-place.title: 具体地点、角色和楼层前漏用 the
errors:missing-the-before-specific-place.explanation: 当说话双方都能明确是哪一个展厅、哪位老师、哪一层楼时，常用定冠词 the：the exhibition hall, the teacher, the second floor。
errors:missing-the-before-specific-place.source: After entering exhibition hall, students turned off their phones and followed teacher to second floor.
errors:missing-the-before-specific-place.example: After entering the exhibition hall, the students turned off their phones and followed the teacher to the second floor.

errors:modal-verb-base-form.title: 情态动词后使用动词原形
errors:modal-verb-base-form.explanation: may、can、must 等情态动词后接动词原形；主语是 you 或 he/she 也不能把 feel 写成 feels。
errors:modal-verb-base-form.source: may、can、must 等情态动词后接动词原形；主语是 you 或 he/she 也不能把 feel 写成 feels。

errors:place-name-spelling-shenzhen.title: 地名 Shenzhen 的拼写
errors:place-name-spelling-shenzhen.explanation: 英文城市名 Shenzhen 要拼作 Shenzhen，不要写成 ShenShen。
errors:place-name-spelling-shenzhen.source: 英文城市名 Shenzhen 要拼作 Shenzhen，不要写成 ShenShen。

errors:restaurant-spelling.title: restaurant 的拼写
errors:restaurant-spelling.explanation: restaurant 正确拼写为 r-e-s-t-a-u-r-a-n-t，中间是 -au-，不要漏掉 a 写成 resturant。
errors:restaurant-spelling.source: The resturant's reviews are very good.
errors:restaurant-spelling.example: The restaurant's reviews are very good.

grammar:relative-clause-who-person.title: who 引导限定性定语从句
grammar:relative-clause-who-person.explanation: who had just arrived... 修饰 a man，用来说明这是怎样的一个人。
grammar:relative-clause-who-person.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
grammar:relative-clause-who-person.example: I spoke to a woman who had recently moved here.

vocabulary:pour-liquid-into-container.title: pour：倒液体
vocabulary:pour-liquid-into-container.explanation: pour 常指让液体从一个容器流入另一个容器，典型宾语是 water、milk、tea、sauce 等；也可说 pour someone a drink。
vocabulary:pour-liquid-into-container.example: Pour the milk into the bowl slowly.
